title: "Student Profile Statistics"
page-layout: full

```{r, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, results='asis'}
library(jsonlite)
library(here)

stats_path <- here("stats/student_stats.json")

if (!file.exists(stats_path)) {
  stop("student_stats.json not found — make sure make_profiles.R ran before quarto render")
}

stats_json <- readLines(stats_path, warn = FALSE) |> paste(collapse = "\n")

cat(sprintf('<script>var STUDENT_DATA = %s;</script>\n', stats_json))
```

```{=html}
};

<!-- ── Loading screen ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
<div id="statsLoader">
  <div class="loader-window">
    <div class="loader-titlebar">
      <div class="loader-dot r"></div>
      <div class="loader-dot y"></div>
      <div class="loader-dot g"></div>
      <div class="loader-wintitle">R Console — bsa_cohort</div>
    </div>
    <div class="loader-body" id="loaderBody">
      <div><span class="loader-prompt">&gt;&nbsp;</span><span id="loaderTyped"></span><span class="loader-cursor" id="loaderCursor"></span></div>
      <div id="loaderOutput"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  var loader = document.getElementById('statsLoader');
  var page   = document.querySelector('.stats-page');

  function showPage() {
    loader.style.display = 'none';
    if (page) { page.style.opacity = '1'; }
  }

  // Skip animation on repeat visits within this browser session
  if (sessionStorage.getItem('bsa_loader_done')) {
    showPage();
    return;
  }

  var typed  = document.getElementById('loaderTyped');
  var cursor = document.getElementById('loaderCursor');
  var output = document.getElementById('loaderOutput');
  var n      = (typeof STUDENT_DATA !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(STUDENT_DATA)) ? STUDENT_DATA.length : '–';

  function wait(ms) { return new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, ms); }); }

  function addLine(html) {
    var d = document.createElement('div');
    d.innerHTML = html;
    output.appendChild(d);
  }

  function typeCmd(str) {
    return new Promise(function (res) {
      var i = 0;
      function tick() {
        if (i < str.length) {
          typed.textContent += str[i++];
          setTimeout(tick, 36 + Math.random() * 26);
        } else { res(); }
      }
      setTimeout(tick, 150);
    });
  }

  typeCmd('library(bsa_cohort)').then(function () {
    cursor.style.display = 'none';
    return wait(100);
  }).then(function () {
    addLine('<span class="loader-dim">── Attaching package: <em>bsa_cohort</em> ──</span>');
    return wait(100);
  }).then(function () {
    addLine('<span class="loader-ok">✔</span> <span class="loader-dim">student_stats.json — ' + n + ' profiles loaded</span>');
    return wait(90);
  }).then(function () {
    addLine('<span class="loader-ok">✔</span> <span class="loader-dim">rendering dashboard...</span>');
    return wait(320);
  }).then(function () {
    sessionStorage.setItem('bsa_loader_done', '1');
    loader.classList.add('fade-out');
    if (page) page.classList.add('visible');
    setTimeout(function () { loader.style.display = 'none'; }, 420);
  });
});
</script>

          <canvas id="chartCandidacy"></canvas>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- UCLA MS → PhD Matriculation (PhD only) -->
    <div id="uclaMsPipelineRow" style="margin-bottom:1.25rem;">
      <div class="charts-row-2">
        <div class="chart-card">
          <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:0.1rem;">
            <div>
              <div class="chart-title">UCLA Matriculation</div>
              <div class="chart-headline">Active PhD Students from UCLA MS</div>
            </div>
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.4rem;font-size:0.78rem;white-space:nowrap;margin-top:0.2rem;">
              <label for="donutYearFrom" style="font-weight:600;color:#2774AE;font-size:0.72rem;">From</label>
              <select id="donutYearFrom" style="font-size:0.72rem;padding:0.15rem 0.35rem;border:1px solid #d0d7df;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;color:#333;cursor:pointer;"></select>
              <label for="donutYearTo" style="font-weight:600;color:#2774AE;font-size:0.72rem;">To</label>
              <select id="donutYearTo" style="font-size:0.72rem;padding:0.15rem 0.35rem;border:1px solid #d0d7df;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;color:#333;cursor:pointer;"></select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="chart-canvas-wrap" style="height:200px;">
            <canvas id="chartUclaMs"></canvas>
          </div>
          <div id="uclaMsInsight" style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#555;line-height:1.5;margin:0.6rem 0 0;text-align:center;"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="chart-card">
          <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:0.25rem;">
            <div>
              <div class="chart-title">Matriculation Over Time</div>
              <div class="chart-headline">UCLA MS → PhD by Cohort Year</div>
            </div>
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.4rem;font-size:0.78rem;color:#555;white-space:nowrap;margin-top:0.2rem;">
              <label for="trendYearFrom" style="font-weight:600;color:#2774AE;">From</label>
              <select id="trendYearFrom" style="font-size:0.75rem;padding:0.2rem 0.4rem;border:1px solid #d0d7df;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;color:#333;cursor:pointer;"></select>
              <label for="trendYearTo" style="font-weight:600;color:#2774AE;">To</label>
              <select id="trendYearTo" style="font-size:0.75rem;padding:0.2rem 0.4rem;border:1px solid #d0d7df;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;color:#333;cursor:pointer;"></select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="chart-canvas-wrap" style="height:220px;">
            <canvas id="chartUclaMsTrend"></canvas>
          </div>
          <p style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#999;margin:0.65rem 0 0;line-height:1.5;">
            * Earlier years only reflect currently active students and do not accurately reflect
            historical pipeline rates — students who have since graduated are excluded from the data.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="chart-card" style="margin-bottom:1.25rem;">
      <div class="chart-title">Bachelor's Degree</div>
      <div class="chart-headline">Top Undergraduate Majors</div>
      <div class="chart-canvas-wrap" style="height:320px;">
        <canvas id="chartMajors"></canvas>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Section: Where They Came From -->
    <div class="section-divider">
      <div class="section-divider-label">Where They Came From</div>
      <div class="section-divider-line"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="chart-card" style="margin-bottom:1.25rem;">
      <div class="chart-title">Undergraduate Institutions</div>
      <div class="chart-headline">Top Schools (Bachelor's)</div>
      <div class="chart-canvas-wrap" style="height:320px;">
        <canvas id="chartSchools"></canvas>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="charts-row-2">
      <div class="chart-card">
        <div class="chart-title">Geographic Origin</div>
        <div class="chart-headline">Domestic vs. International</div>
        <div class="chart-canvas-wrap" style="height:240px;">
          <canvas id="chartGeo"></canvas>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="chart-card">
        <div class="chart-title">US Undergrad Locations</div>
        <div class="chart-headline">Top States (Domestic)</div>
        <div class="chart-canvas-wrap" style="height:240px;">
          <canvas id="chartStates"></canvas>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Section: Advising -->
    <div class="section-divider">
      <div class="section-divider-label">Advising</div>
      <div class="section-divider-line"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Advisor type definitions -->
    <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:1rem; margin-bottom:1.5rem;">
      <div style="background:#f8fafc; border-left:4px solid #2774AE; border-radius:0 8px 8px 0; padding:1rem 1.25rem;">
        <div style="font-size:0.7rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.08em; color:#2774AE; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:0.35rem;">Academic Advisor</div>
        <div style="font-size:0.88rem; color:#333; line-height:1.6;">Assigned initially to assist students with course requirements in their earlier years. All PhD, MS, and MDSH students are assigned an academic advisor upon enrollment.</div>
      </div>
      <div style="background:#f8fafc; border-left:4px solid #FFD100; border-radius:0 8px 8px 0; padding:1rem 1.25rem;">
        <div style="font-size:0.7rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.08em; color:#b8960c; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:0.35rem;">Research Advisor</div>
        <div style="font-size:0.88rem; color:#333; line-height:1.6;">A faculty member who supervises a student's thesis or dissertation research. Typically selected after a student identifies their research area and focus. Primarily associated with PhD students and research-track programs.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="charts-row-2">
      <div class="chart-card">
        <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; margin-bottom:0.25rem;">
          <div>
            <div class="chart-title">Faculty</div>
            <div class="chart-headline">Most Common Advisors</div>
          </div>
          <div style="display:flex;gap:0.4rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-top:0.25rem;">
            <button id="advisorFilterAll" class="adv-filter-btn adv-filter-active" data-filter="all" style="font-size:0.75rem;padding:0.25rem 0.6rem;border:1px solid #2774AE;background:#2774AE;color:#fff;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;">All</button>
            <button id="advisorFilterResearch" class="adv-filter-btn" data-filter="research" style="font-size:0.75rem;padding:0.25rem 0.6rem;border:1px solid #2774AE;background:#fff;color:#2774AE;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;">Research</button>
            <button id="advisorFilterAcademic" class="adv-filter-btn" data-filter="academic" style="font-size:0.75rem;padding:0.25rem 0.6rem;border:1px solid #e8a000;background:#fff;color:#e8a000;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;">Academic</button>
            <button id="advisorViewToggle" style="font-size:0.75rem;padding:0.25rem 0.6rem;border:1px solid #aaa;background:#fff;color:#555;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;">Show List</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div id="advisorChartWrap">
          <div class="chart-canvas-wrap" style="height:300px;">
            <canvas id="chartAdvisors"></canvas>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div id="advisorListWrap" class="hidden" style="padding:0.25rem 0 0.5rem;">
          <div id="advisorListContent"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="chart-card">
        <div class="chart-title">Advisor Type</div>
        <div class="chart-headline">Research vs. Academic</div>
        <div class="chart-canvas-wrap" style="height:300px;">
          <canvas id="chartAdvisorType"></canvas>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div><!-- end #statsContent -->
</div><!-- end .stats-page -->


<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  /* ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var BLUE    = '#2774AE';
  var GOLD    = '#FFD100';
  var MID     = '#005587';
  var TEAL    = '#00a693';
  var PALETTE = [BLUE, '#e8a000', TEAL, '#8b5cf6', '#ef4444', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#6366f1', '#ec4899', '#14b8a6'];

  function el(id)   { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function show(id) { var e = el(id); if (e) e.classList.remove('hidden'); }
  function hide(id) { var e = el(id); if (e) e.classList.add('hidden');    }

  function pct(n, total) {
    if (!total) return '0%';
    return Math.round(n / total * 100) + '%';
  }

  function topN(obj, n) {
    return Object.entries(obj)
      .sort(function (a, b) { return b[1] - a[1]; })
      .slice(0, n);
  }

  /* ── Chart factory ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var chartInstances = {};

  function makeDonut(canvasId, labels, data, colors) {
    var ctx = el(canvasId);
    if (!ctx) return;
    if (chartInstances[canvasId]) {
      var ch = chartInstances[canvasId];
      ch.data.labels = labels;
      ch.data.datasets[0].data = data;
      ch.data.datasets[0].backgroundColor = colors;
      ch.update('none');
      return;
    }
    chartInstances[canvasId] = new Chart(ctx, {
      type: 'doughnut',
      data: { labels: labels, datasets: [{ data: data, backgroundColor: colors, borderWidth: 2, borderColor: '#fff', hoverOffset: 6 }] },
      options: {
        responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, cutout: '62%',
        plugins: {
          legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { padding: 16, font: { size: 12 }, color: '#444', usePointStyle: true, pointStyleWidth: 10 } },
          tooltip: { callbacks: { label: function (ctx) { var s = ctx.parsed; var t = ctx.dataset.data.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0); return ' ' + ctx.label + ': ' + s + ' (' + pct(s, t) + ')'; } } }
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function makeHBar(canvasId, labels, data, color) {
    var ctx = el(canvasId);
    if (!ctx) return;
    if (chartInstances[canvasId]) {
      var ch = chartInstances[canvasId];
      ch.data.labels = labels;
      ch.data.datasets[0].data = data;
      ch.update('none');
      return;
    }
    chartInstances[canvasId] = new Chart(ctx, {
      type: 'bar',
      data: { labels: labels, datasets: [{ data: data, backgroundColor: color || BLUE, borderRadius: 5, borderSkipped: false }] },
      options: {
        indexAxis: 'y', responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
        plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { callbacks: { label: function (c) { return ' ' + c.parsed.x + ' students'; } } } },
        scales: {
          x: { beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' }, ticks: { color: '#555', stepSize: 1 } },
          y: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: '#333', font: { size: 12 } } }
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function makeStackedBar(canvasId, labels, datasets) {
    var ctx = el(canvasId);
    if (!ctx) return;
    if (chartInstances[canvasId] && chartInstances[canvasId].data.datasets.length === datasets.length) {
      var ch = chartInstances[canvasId];
      ch.data.labels = labels;
      datasets.forEach(function (d, i) {
        ch.data.datasets[i].data  = d.data;
        ch.data.datasets[i].label = d.label;
      });
      ch.update('none');
      return;
    }
    if (chartInstances[canvasId]) chartInstances[canvasId].destroy();
    chartInstances[canvasId] = new Chart(ctx, {
      type: 'bar',
      data: { labels: labels, datasets: datasets.map(function (d) { return { label: d.label, data: d.data, backgroundColor: d.color, borderRadius: 4, borderSkipped: false }; }) },
      options: {
        responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
        plugins: {
          legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { padding: 14, font: { size: 11 }, color: '#444', usePointStyle: true, pointStyleWidth: 10 } },
          tooltip: { mode: 'index', intersect: false }
        },
        scales: {
          x: { stacked: true, grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' }, ticks: { color: '#555' } },
          y: { stacked: true, grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' }, ticks: { color: '#555', stepSize: 1 } }
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function makeStackedHBar(canvasId, labels, datasets) {
    var ctx = el(canvasId);
    if (!ctx) return;
    if (chartInstances[canvasId] && chartInstances[canvasId].data.datasets.length === datasets.length) {
      var ch = chartInstances[canvasId];
      ch.data.labels = labels;
      datasets.forEach(function (d, i) {
        ch.data.datasets[i].data  = d.data;
        ch.data.datasets[i].label = d.label;
        ch.data.datasets[i].backgroundColor = d.color;
      });
      ch.update('none');
      return;
    }
    if (chartInstances[canvasId]) chartInstances[canvasId].destroy();
    chartInstances[canvasId] = new Chart(ctx, {
      type: 'bar',
      data: { labels: labels, datasets: datasets.map(function (d) { return { label: d.label, data: d.data, backgroundColor: d.color, borderRadius: 4, borderSkipped: false }; }) },
      options: {
        indexAxis: 'y', responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
        plugins: {
          legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { padding: 14, font: { size: 11 }, color: '#444', usePointStyle: true, pointStyleWidth: 10 } },
          tooltip: { mode: 'index', axis: 'y', intersect: false, callbacks: { label: function (c) { return ' ' + c.dataset.label + ': ' + c.parsed.x; } } }
        },
        scales: {
          x: { stacked: true, beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' }, ticks: { color: '#555', stepSize: 1 } },
          y: { stacked: true, grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: '#333', font: { size: 12 } } }
        }
      }
    });
  }

  /* ── Global state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var _rows          = [];
  var _alumniCount   = 0;
  var _sel           = { PhD: true, MS: true, MDSH: true };
  var _advisorFilter = 'all'; // 'all' | 'research' | 'academic'
  var _trendYearFrom  = null;  // null = no filter
  var _trendYearTo    = null;
  var _donutYearFrom  = null;
  var _donutYearTo    = null;
  // cached data for partial re-renders
  var _filteredRows   = [];
  var _advRaw         = [];
  var _uclaMsByYear   = {};

  /* ── Process pre-cleaned JSON from make_profiles.R ───────────────────── */
  function processData(rawRows) {

    // Map JSON fields → internal row format
    // All normalisation (program names, advisor names, majors, schools,
    // locations) was already done in R — no JS normalizers needed here
    var allRows = rawRows.map(function (r) {
      return {
        program:     r.program,
        candidacy:   r.candidacy === 'candidate' ? 'yes' : 'no',
        cohortYear:  r.cohortYear || '',
        hasMasters:  !!r.hasMasters,
        bsMajor:     r.bsMajor  || null,
        bsSchool:    r.bsSchool || null,
        bsLoc:        { country: r.bsCountry || null, state: r.bsState || null },
        advisors:     [r.advisor1, r.advisor2].filter(function (a) { return a; }),
        advisorType:  (r.advisorType || '').toLowerCase(),
        mastersSchool: r.mastersSchool || null,
        mastersMajor:  r.mastersMajor  || null,
        alumni:       !!r.alumni
      };
    });

    _alumniCount = allRows.filter(function (r) { return r.alumni; }).length;
    _rows        = allRows.filter(function (r) { return !r.alumni; });

    // Completion rates
    function fillCompletion(pctId, fracId, barId, resp, total) {
      var p = Math.round(resp / total * 100);
      el(pctId).textContent  = p + '%';
      el(fracId).textContent = resp + ' / ' + total;
      el(barId).style.width  = Math.min(p, 100) + '%';
    }
    var T  = window.TOTALS;
    var Y1 = window.COHORT_1ST_YEAR;
    var Y2 = window.COHORT_2ND_YEAR;
    fillCompletion('phdCompletePct',   'phdCompleteFrac',   'phdCompleteBar',
      _rows.filter(function (r) { return r.program === 'PhD'; }).length, T.PhD.all);
    fillCompletion('ms1CompletePct',   'ms1CompleteFrac',   'ms1CompleteBar',
      _rows.filter(function (r) { return r.program === 'MS'   && r.cohortYear === Y1; }).length, T.MS[Y1]);
    fillCompletion('ms2CompletePct',   'ms2CompleteFrac',   'ms2CompleteBar',
      _rows.filter(function (r) { return r.program === 'MS'   && r.cohortYear === Y2; }).length, T.MS[Y2]);
    fillCompletion('mdsh1CompletePct', 'mdsh1CompleteFrac', 'mdsh1CompleteBar',
      _rows.filter(function (r) { return r.program === 'MDSH' && r.cohortYear === Y1; }).length, T.MDSH[Y1]);
    fillCompletion('mdsh2CompletePct', 'mdsh2CompleteFrac', 'mdsh2CompleteBar',
      _rows.filter(function (r) { return r.program === 'MDSH' && r.cohortYear === Y2; }).length, T.MDSH[Y2]);

    // Stamp the build date (set by R at render time, not the visitor's clock)
    var lu = el('lastUpdated');
    if (lu) lu.textContent = 'Data as of: ' + new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });

    renderKPIs();
    setupFilters();
    renderAll();
    show('statsContent');
  }

  /* ── KPI cards ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function renderKPIs() {
    var programs   = {};
    var candidates = 0;
    _rows.forEach(function (r) {
      programs[r.program] = (programs[r.program] || 0) + 1;
      if (r.program === 'PhD' && r.candidacy === 'yes') candidates++;
    });
    el('kpiTotal').textContent  = _rows.length;
    el('kpiPhd').textContent    = programs['PhD']  || 0;
    el('kpiMs').textContent     = programs['MS']   || 0;
    el('kpiMdsh').textContent   = programs['MDSH'] || 0;
    el('kpiAlumni').textContent = _alumniCount;
    var candSub = el('kpiCandSub');
    if (candSub) candSub.textContent = candidates > 0 ? 'incl. ' + candidates + ' candidates' : '';
  }

  /* ── Filter buttons ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function setupFilters() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var prog = btn.getAttribute('data-prog');
        if (prog === 'all') {
          _sel = { PhD: true, MS: true, MDSH: true };
        } else {
          _sel[prog] = !_sel[prog];
          if (!_sel.PhD && !_sel.MS && !_sel.MDSH) _sel = { PhD: true, MS: true, MDSH: true };
        }
        syncFilterBtns();
        renderAll();
      });
    });
    syncFilterBtns();

    var togBtn = el('advisorViewToggle');
    if (togBtn) {
      togBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var chartWrap = el('advisorChartWrap');
        var listWrap  = el('advisorListWrap');
        if (listWrap.classList.contains('hidden')) {
          listWrap.classList.remove('hidden');
          chartWrap.classList.add('hidden');
          togBtn.textContent = 'Show Chart';
        } else {
          listWrap.classList.add('hidden');
          chartWrap.classList.remove('hidden');
          togBtn.textContent = 'Show List';
        }
      });
    }

    // Year-range selects for matriculation trend chart
    (function () {
      var allYears = Object.keys(_rows.reduce(function (acc, r) {
        if (r.cohortYear) acc[r.cohortYear] = 1;
        return acc;
      }, {})).sort();
      var fromSel = el('trendYearFrom');
      var toSel   = el('trendYearTo');
      if (!fromSel || !toSel || !allYears.length) return;
      allYears.forEach(function (y) {
        fromSel.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement('option'), { value: y, textContent: y }));
        toSel.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement('option'), { value: y, textContent: y }));
      });
      fromSel.value    = allYears[Math.max(0, allYears.length - 3)];
      toSel.value      = allYears[allYears.length - 1];
      _trendYearFrom   = allYears[Math.max(0, allYears.length - 3)];
      _trendYearTo     = allYears[allYears.length - 1];
      fromSel.addEventListener('change', function () {
        _trendYearFrom = fromSel.value;
        if (_trendYearFrom > _trendYearTo) { _trendYearTo = _trendYearFrom; toSel.value = _trendYearFrom; }
        renderMatriculationTrend();
      });
      toSel.addEventListener('change', function () {
        _trendYearTo = toSel.value;
        if (_trendYearTo < _trendYearFrom) { _trendYearFrom = _trendYearTo; fromSel.value = _trendYearTo; }
        renderMatriculationTrend();
      });
    }());

    // Year-range selects for matriculation donut chart
    (function () {
      var allYears = Object.keys(_rows.reduce(function (acc, r) {
        if (r.cohortYear) acc[r.cohortYear] = 1;
        return acc;
      }, {})).sort();
      var fromSel = el('donutYearFrom');
      var toSel   = el('donutYearTo');
      if (!fromSel || !toSel || !allYears.length) return;
      allYears.forEach(function (y) {
        fromSel.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement('option'), { value: y, textContent: y }));
        toSel.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement('option'), { value: y, textContent: y }));
      });
      fromSel.value  = allYears[Math.max(0, allYears.length - 3)];
      toSel.value    = allYears[allYears.length - 1];
      _donutYearFrom = allYears[Math.max(0, allYears.length - 3)];
      _donutYearTo   = allYears[allYears.length - 1];
      fromSel.addEventListener('change', function () {
        _donutYearFrom = fromSel.value;
        if (_donutYearFrom > _donutYearTo) { _donutYearTo = _donutYearFrom; toSel.value = _donutYearFrom; }
        renderMatriculationDonut();
      });
      toSel.addEventListener('change', function () {
        _donutYearTo = toSel.value;
        if (_donutYearTo < _donutYearFrom) { _donutYearFrom = _donutYearTo; fromSel.value = _donutYearTo; }
        renderMatriculationDonut();
      });
    }());

    // Advisor type filter buttons
    document.querySelectorAll('.adv-filter-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        _advisorFilter = btn.getAttribute('data-filter');
        document.querySelectorAll('.adv-filter-btn').forEach(function (b) {
          var isResearch = b.getAttribute('data-filter') === 'research';
          var activeColor = isResearch ? '#2774AE' : (b.getAttribute('data-filter') === 'academic' ? '#e8a000' : '#2774AE');
          var active = b === btn;
          b.style.background = active ? activeColor : '#fff';
          b.style.color = active ? '#fff' : activeColor;
        });
        renderAdvisors();
      });
    });
  }

  function syncFilterBtns() {
    var allOn = _sel.PhD && _sel.MS && _sel.MDSH;
    document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
      var prog = btn.getAttribute('data-prog');
      btn.classList.toggle('active', prog === 'all' ? allOn : !!_sel[prog]);
    });
    var fc = el('filterCount');
    if (fc) {
      if (allOn) {
        fc.textContent = 'Showing all ' + _rows.length + ' students';
      } else {
        var names = Object.keys(_sel).filter(function (k) { return _sel[k]; });
        var count = _rows.filter(function (r) { return _sel[r.program]; }).length;
        fc.textContent = 'Showing ' + count + ' students (' + names.join(' + ') + ')';
      }
    }
  }

  /* ── Major standardization ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function standardizeMajor(m) {
    m = m.trim();
    if (/^statistics\s+and\s+data\s+science$/i.test(m))       return 'Statistics & Data Science';
    if (/^statistics$/i.test(m))                              return 'Statistics';
    if (/^data\s*science$/i.test(m))                          return 'Data Science';
    if (/^applied\s*math(ematics)?$/i.test(m))                return 'Applied Mathematics';
    if (/^applied\s*math/i.test(m) && /statistics/i.test(m)) return 'Applied Mathematics & Statistics';
    if (/^(pure\s*)?math(ematics)?$/i.test(m))                return 'Mathematics';
    if (/molecular.*cell|cell.*molecular/i.test(m))           return 'Molecular & Cell Biology';
    if (/biological\s*science/i.test(m))                      return 'Biological Sciences';
    if (/^biology$/i.test(m))                                 return 'Biology';
    if (/^biostatistics$/i.test(m))                           return 'Biostatistics';
    if (/^computer\s*science$/i.test(m))                      return 'Computer Science';
    if (/public\s*health/i.test(m))                           return 'Public Health';
    return m;
  }

  /* ── Render all charts ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function renderAll() {
    var filtered = _rows.filter(function (r) { return _sel[r.program]; });
    var total    = filtered.length;

    var programs         = {};
    var cohortByYear     = {};
    var phdHasMasters    = { "Has Master's": 0, "No Master's": 0 };
    var candidacy        = { Candidate: 0, Student: 0 };
    var bsMajors         = {};
    var bsSchools        = {};
    var countries        = {};
    var usStates         = {};
    var advisorBreakdown = {};
    var advisorTypes     = { Research: 0, Academic: 0, Other: 0 };
    var multiAdvisor     = 0;
    var phdTotal         = 0;
    var uclaMs           = 0;               // PhD students whose master's school is UCLA
    var uclaMsByYear     = {};              // cohortYear → { uclaMs, other }

    filtered.forEach(function (r) {
      programs[r.program] = (programs[r.program] || 0) + 1;
      if (r.program === 'PhD') phdTotal++;

      if (r.cohortYear) {
        if (!cohortByYear[r.cohortYear]) cohortByYear[r.cohortYear] = { PhD: 0, MS: 0, MDSH: 0 };
        cohortByYear[r.cohortYear][r.program] = (cohortByYear[r.cohortYear][r.program] || 0) + 1;
      }

      if (r.program === 'PhD') {
        phdHasMasters[r.hasMasters ? "Has Master's" : "No Master's"]++;
        if (r.candidacy === 'yes') candidacy.Candidate++;
        else candidacy.Student++;

        // UCLA MS → PhD pipeline
        var fromUcla = r.mastersSchool && /^university of california,? los angeles$|^ucla$/i.test(r.mastersSchool.trim())
                    && r.mastersMajor && /biostatistics/i.test(r.mastersMajor);
        if (fromUcla) uclaMs++;
        if (r.cohortYear) {
          if (!uclaMsByYear[r.cohortYear]) uclaMsByYear[r.cohortYear] = { uclaMs: 0, other: 0 };
          if (fromUcla) uclaMsByYear[r.cohortYear].uclaMs++;
          else          uclaMsByYear[r.cohortYear].other++;
        }
      }

      if (r.bsMajor) {
        r.bsMajor.split(/\s*&\s*/).forEach(function (part) {
          var key = standardizeMajor(part);
          bsMajors[key] = (bsMajors[key] || 0) + 1;
        });
      }
      if (r.bsSchool) bsSchools[r.bsSchool] = (bsSchools[r.bsSchool] || 0) + 1;

      if (r.bsLoc.country) {
        countries[r.bsLoc.country] = (countries[r.bsLoc.country] || 0) + 1;
        if (r.bsLoc.country === 'United States' && r.bsLoc.state)
          usStates[r.bsLoc.state] = (usStates[r.bsLoc.state] || 0) + 1;
      }

      var advType = r.advisorType.includes('research') ? 'Research'
                  : r.advisorType.includes('academic') ? 'Academic' : null;
      if (advType) advisorTypes[advType]++;
      else if (r.advisorType) advisorTypes.Other++;

      r.advisors.forEach(function (a) {
        if (!advisorBreakdown[a]) advisorBreakdown[a] = { Research: 0, Academic: 0 };
        advisorBreakdown[a][advType || 'Research']++;
      });

      if (r.advisors.length > 1) multiAdvisor++;
    });

    // Insight pills
    var insightData = _sel.PhD
      ? [
          { num: pct(phdHasMasters["Has Master's"], phdTotal || 1), text: "of PhD students came with a prior Master's degree" },
          { num: pct(multiAdvisor, total),                          text: 'have more than one faculty advisor' },
          { num: pct(countries['United States'] || 0, total),       text: 'did their undergrad at a US institution' },
          { num: pct(candidacy.Candidate, phdTotal || 1),           text: 'of PhD students have advanced to candidacy' }
        ]
      : (function () {
          var pills = [
            { num: pct(countries['United States'] || 0, total), text: 'did their undergrad at a US institution' },
            { num: pct(advisorTypes.Research, total),            text: 'have a research advisor' }
          ];
          if (_sel.MS && !_sel.PhD && !_sel.MDSH) {
            // MS-only: show % of active PhD students who came from UCLA MS
            var allPhd = _rows.filter(function (r) { return r.program === 'PhD' && !r.alumni; });
            var allPhdTotal = allPhd.length;
            var uclaFromMs = allPhd.filter(function (r) {
              return r.mastersSchool && /^university of california,? los angeles$|^ucla$/i.test(r.mastersSchool.trim())
                  && r.mastersMajor && /biostatistics/i.test(r.mastersMajor);
            }).length;
            pills.push({ num: pct(uclaFromMs, allPhdTotal || 1), text: 'of active PhD students matriculated from the UCLA MS program' });
          }
          return pills;
        }());
    var ir = el('insightRow');
    if (ir) ir.innerHTML = insightData.map(function (d) {
      return '<div class="insight-pill"><div class="insight-num">' + d.num + '</div><div class="insight-text">' + d.text + '</div></div>';
    }).join('');

    var progLabels = Object.keys(programs);
    makeDonut('chartProgram', progLabels, progLabels.map(function (l) { return programs[l]; }),
      progLabels.map(function (l) { return l === 'PhD' ? BLUE : l === 'MS' ? MID : l === 'MDSH' ? TEAL : '#999'; }));

    var sortedYears = Object.keys(cohortByYear).sort();
    makeStackedBar('chartCohort', sortedYears, [
      { label: 'PhD',  data: sortedYears.map(function (y) { return cohortByYear[y].PhD  || 0; }), color: BLUE },
      { label: 'MS',   data: sortedYears.map(function (y) { return cohortByYear[y].MS   || 0; }), color: MID  },
      { label: 'MDSH', data: sortedYears.map(function (y) { return cohortByYear[y].MDSH || 0; }), color: TEAL }
    ]);

    var phdRow = el('phdChartsRow');
    if (phdRow) phdRow.style.display = _sel.PhD ? '' : 'none';

    var pipelineRow = el('uclaMsPipelineRow');
    if (pipelineRow) pipelineRow.style.display = _sel.PhD ? '' : 'none';

    _filteredRows = filtered;
    _uclaMsByYear = uclaMsByYear;
    if (_sel.PhD) {
      renderMatriculationDonut();
      renderMatriculationTrend();
    }

    makeDonut('chartMasters', Object.keys(phdHasMasters), Object.values(phdHasMasters), [BLUE, '#e0e7ef']);

    var candLabels = ['Candidate', 'Student'];
    makeDonut('chartCandidacy', candLabels, candLabels.map(function (l) { return candidacy[l]; }), ['#e8a000', '#e0e7ef']);

    var topMajors = topN(bsMajors, 10);
    makeHBar('chartMajors', topMajors.map(function (e) { return e[0]; }), topMajors.map(function (e) { return e[1]; }), BLUE);

    var topSchools = topN(bsSchools, 10);
    makeHBar('chartSchools', topSchools.map(function (e) { return e[0]; }), topSchools.map(function (e) { return e[1]; }), MID);

    var domestic = countries['United States'] || 0;
    var international = Object.entries(countries).reduce(function (s, e) { return e[0] !== 'United States' ? s + e[1] : s; }, 0);
    makeDonut('chartGeo', ['Domestic', 'International'], [domestic, international], [BLUE, GOLD]);

    var topStates = topN(usStates, 8);
    makeHBar('chartStates', topStates.map(function (e) { return e[0]; }), topStates.map(function (e) { return e[1]; }), TEAL);

    _advRaw = Object.entries(advisorBreakdown)
      .map(function (e) { return { name: e[0], r: e[1].Research, a: e[1].Academic, total: e[1].Research + e[1].Academic }; });
    renderAdvisors();

    var advTypeLabels = Object.keys(advisorTypes).filter(function (k) { return advisorTypes[k] > 0; });
    makeDonut('chartAdvisorType', advTypeLabels, advTypeLabels.map(function (k) { return advisorTypes[k]; }),
      [BLUE, '#e8a000', TEAL]);
  }

  /* ── Sub-renderers (called independently by filter listeners) ─────────── */
  function renderAdvisors() {
    var topAdvList;
    if (_advisorFilter === 'research') {
      topAdvList = _advRaw.filter(function (e) { return e.r > 0; }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.r - a.r; }).slice(0, 10);
    } else if (_advisorFilter === 'academic') {
      topAdvList = _advRaw.filter(function (e) { return e.a > 0; }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.a - a.a; }).slice(0, 10);
    } else {
      topAdvList = _advRaw.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return b.total - a.total; }).slice(0, 10);
    }
    var advDatasets = [];
    if (_advisorFilter !== 'academic') advDatasets.push({ label: 'Research', data: topAdvList.map(function (e) { return e.r; }), color: BLUE });
    if (_advisorFilter !== 'research') advDatasets.push({ label: 'Academic', data: topAdvList.map(function (e) { return e.a; }), color: '#e8a000' });
    makeStackedHBar('chartAdvisors', topAdvList.map(function (e) { return e.name; }), advDatasets);

    var allAdvList = _advRaw.slice();
    if (_advisorFilter === 'research') {
      allAdvList = allAdvList.filter(function (e) { return e.r > 0; }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.r - a.r; });
    } else if (_advisorFilter === 'academic') {
      allAdvList = allAdvList.filter(function (e) { return e.a > 0; }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.a - a.a; });
    } else {
      allAdvList = allAdvList.sort(function (a, b) { return b.total - a.total; });
    }
    var listEl = el('advisorListContent');
    if (listEl) listEl.innerHTML = allAdvList.map(function (adv) {
      var parts = [];
      if (adv.r) parts.push(adv.r + ' research');
      if (adv.a) parts.push(adv.a + ' academic');
      return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:0.45rem 0.25rem;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f4f8;">'
        + '<span style="font-weight:500;color:#1a2744;">' + adv.name + '</span>'
        + '<span style="color:#555;font-size:0.88rem;">' + adv.total + ' student' + (adv.total !== 1 ? 's' : '')
        + (parts.length ? ' <span style="color:#999;font-size:0.82rem;">(' + parts.join(', ') + ')</span>' : '')
        + '</span></div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  function renderMatriculationDonut() {
    var donutPhd = _filteredRows.filter(function (r) {
      return r.program === 'PhD'
        && (!_donutYearFrom || r.cohortYear >= _donutYearFrom)
        && (!_donutYearTo   || r.cohortYear <= _donutYearTo);
    });
    var donutTotal  = donutPhd.length;
    var donutUclaMs = donutPhd.filter(function (r) {
      return r.mastersSchool && /^university of california,? los angeles$|^ucla$/i.test(r.mastersSchool.trim())
          && r.mastersMajor  && /biostatistics/i.test(r.mastersMajor);
    }).length;
    var uclaPct   = donutTotal ? Math.round(donutUclaMs / donutTotal * 100) : 0;
    var yearLabel = (_donutYearFrom === _donutYearTo)
      ? 'cohort ' + _donutYearFrom
      : 'cohort years ' + _donutYearFrom + '\u2013' + _donutYearTo;
    var insight = el('uclaMsInsight');
    if (insight) {
      insight.innerHTML = '<strong style="color:#2774AE;font-size:1.05rem;">' + uclaPct + '%</strong>'
        + ' completed their master\'s at UCLA before joining the PhD program'
        + ' <span style="color:#999;font-size:0.82rem;">(' + yearLabel + ')</span>';
    }
    makeDonut('chartUclaMs',
      ['From UCLA Biostat MS', 'Other Background'],
      [donutUclaMs, donutTotal - donutUclaMs],
      [GOLD, '#e0e7ef']);
  }

  function renderMatriculationTrend() {
    var trendYears = Object.keys(_uclaMsByYear).sort().filter(function (y) {
      return (!_trendYearFrom || y >= _trendYearFrom) && (!_trendYearTo || y <= _trendYearTo);
    });
    makeStackedBar('chartUclaMsTrend', trendYears, [
      { label: 'From UCLA Biostat MS', data: trendYears.map(function (y) { return _uclaMsByYear[y].uclaMs; }), color: GOLD },
      { label: 'Other',                data: trendYears.map(function (y) { return _uclaMsByYear[y].other;  }), color: BLUE }
    ]);
  }

  /* ── Boot — data was inlined at render time by the R chunk ───────────── */
  if (typeof STUDENT_DATA !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(STUDENT_DATA)) {
    processData(STUDENT_DATA);
  } else {
    el('errorMsg').textContent = 'Student data was not embedded at build time. Make sure make_profiles.R ran before quarto render.';
    show('errorCard');
  }

})();
</script>
```
